name: edel
description: Edel PERPS public API skill plus the public Edel MCP for Development and TestNet, authenticated with your own API key.

development_api_key.title: Development MCP API key
development_api_key.description: Your own Edel API key for Development (edel_ak_...), approved with your passkey. Stored in the OS secure credential store. Leave empty to skip Development.

testnet_api_key.title: TestNet MCP API key
testnet_api_key.description: Your own Edel API key for TestNet (edel_ak_...), approved with your passkey. Stored in the OS secure credential store. Leave empty to skip TestNet.
